name: Sam's Club Cafe (Logan & Riverdale, UT) Vanilla Soft-Serve Root Beer Float
whyItWorks: Caffeine-free root beer poured over vanilla soft-serve ice cream. Seedless, citrus-free, and satisfying during warehouse shopping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Root Beer Float; let carbonation settle slightly before drinking to prevent gas bloating.
watchOuts: Carbonation and dairy lactose can cause mild bloating
